title: Power Star Alix Lapri Open to Playing Britney Spears in Biopic
htmlContent:
Alix Lapri, who stars as Effie Morales in Power Book II: Ghost, recently expressed her enthusiasm about playing pop icon Britney Spears in a biographical film. During an interview with The Danza Project, Lapri expressed her excitement about taking on the role of the legendary singer.
"Absolutely, I would," Lapri eagerly responded. "Oh, I listen to it all the time—in the car, at the house, everything."
Britney's music and career are evident in her enthusiasm, revealing her admiration for the pop star's work. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bIQd3_qW-Ds Lapri’s affinity for Britney Spears goes beyond casual admiration. She has openly shared her love for the artist, even calling Britney her GOAT (Greatest of All Time) earlier in the interview. Due to her passion for Britney's music and legacy, the possibility of Lapri portraying Spears on screen is intriguing. As one of the most influential pop stars of the late 1990s and 2000s, Britney Spears has had an illustrious career that has included successes and setbacks. This makes her life the perfect subject for a compelling biopic. Lapri's rising stardom and versatility in acting could add depth and understanding to the portrayal of Britney's journey. There are no specific plans for a Britney Spears biopic, but with Lapri's interest, fans can imagine the potential of seeing her portray the pop icon on the big screen. With her acting skills and clear admiration for Britney, Lapri could be an exciting choice for the role if such a project comes to life.
